sampling.order: Row-major, x fastest; row 0 is BOTTOM; DataTexture.flipY=false
sampling.uv: u=(alpha+21)/42; v=(beta+14)/28; alpha increases right, beta increases up

physics.observer: Stationary at asymptotic infinity; initial u=0 exactly
physics.disk: Opaque, infinitesimally thin equatorial disk; positive-phi circular Keplerian motion
physics.direction: Positive backward Mino time; u_initial=0, u_prime=1, mu=cos(i), mu_prime=beta*sin(i); phi_prime is negative future Carter expression
physics.patternAdvection: For positive-phi rotating material use pattern(phi-Omega*t). No retarded emission-time map is included.

integration.diskEvent: Bracketed Newton event refinement by partial-step reintegration
integration.turningPoints: Second-order separated Carter equations; no square-root sign switching

limitations: Fixed observer and spin, single ray per texel; not DNGR ray bundles or an IMAX reproduction.
Near-pole azimuth convergence is validated for the production 768x512 map (nearest nonzero |alpha|=0.02734375 M), not arbitrary infinitesimal nonzero angular momentum.
No volumetric disk, radiative transfer, plasma, magnetic field, self-gravity, lens flare, or emission-time delay.
Texture encodes disk transfer and horizon/escape classification, not a celestial-sphere deflection map.
Subpixel critical-curve images require runtime antialiasing; map does not promise resolution of arbitrarily high image orders.

sources.sections: Appendix A.1 Eqs.4–6,12,15; A.6; section4 for film spin and frequency-shift choices
sources.implementation: Original separated-geodesic implementation; no paper images or DNGR source code copied.
